pr_body:
Closes [#9856](https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/9856)

Details:
The PR adds a CLI command: 
`airflow connection export --format=<format> --output-file=/path/to/your/file/name.json`

It exports connections in the following formats: `json`, `yaml` and `env`.

The exported connections are the list of all saved connections in the airflow metadatabase.

issue_context.title: Export connection/variable to file
issue_context.body:
Hello,

We have a ticket about importing connections and variable
https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/9855

- `airflow connections export`
- `airflow variables export`

To facilitate the management, it would also be useful to create this file using the CLI. We should support 3 file formats.

Best regards,
Kamil Breguła
comments: @mik-laj I'd like to work on this. Can you assign this to me?
@rootcss I assigned you to this ticket

@mik-laj Just to be clear about the scope of this issue, describing it here:
We should have a CLI command: `airflow connection export --format=<format> --output-file=/path/to/your/file/name.json`
It should export it in the following formats: `json`, `yaml` and `env`.

The exported connections should be the list of all saved connections in the airflow metadatabase.

Let me know what do you think about this.

@rootcss  SGTM. It is worth writing documentation for this, which will describe this command. I am thinking of an extra section on this page
https://airflow.readthedocs.io/en/latest/howto/connection/index.html

Can this be closed @mik-laj ? 

i am closing it for now -- let me know if you feel that we need to do more here

review_comments: Can you add examples of calls for this command in the command description (description parameter not help parameter)?
The help parameter appears in the task list, but the description parameter is available for help. For example: see `airflow dags show --help`.
I think it is worth giving the option to choose the format with the additional --format parameter. This will overwrite the value detected based on the file name.

Users may not have an extension if exporting to a temporary file - `mktemp`.
```bash
TMP_FILE="$(mktemp)"
airflow connections export "${TMP_FILE}" --format=json
scp "${TMP_FILE}" mik-laj@yourserver:/home/mik-laj/backup/export-$(hostname)
rm "${TMP_FILE}"
```
Is this use case correct for you?
Yes, Will add this, along with the documentation.
It would be valuable to test also for emergency situations when an operation fails, or the user gives an incorrect value as a parameter.
Yes, this was just a draft to confirm the functionality. Will be adding the tests for all scenarios.
